## Reconciliation — duplicate r2 deliveries in this thread (read before gate verification)

Two concurrent runs were preserved by runtime reconciliation (parent comment 01a0ddc3-8758, no cancellation), and each delivered an r2 in this thread. They are **not** the same bytes:

- `01a0ddc4-05ca` — canonical digest `5fba147a9bc32231fa3cea99d04eb7300390485de340bc1521cbd35f89b4176e` (4122 bytes)
- `01a0ddc4-8de5` (this run's delivery) — canonical digest `9358f1cdeba9f9e8895baf9c3a18318fa47cb8665d05e9a763f118d6489ad8df` (4230 bytes)

Content is identical in every field except the wording of the 6th `limitations` entry (the classification rationale); both satisfy the correction requirements (conflictRefs emptied, RC10VAL-8/9 moved to sourceRefs, everything else preserved, product issues untouched).

Disposition per the duplicate rule: the Orchestrator fan-in (parent `01a0ddc5-dad2`) has already bound digest `5fba147a…` as the canonical r2 and dispatched C2 review@2 against it. Accordingly, **canonical r2 = comment `01a0ddc4-05ca` (digest `5fba147a…`); this run's `01a0ddc4-8de5` (digest `9358f1cd…`) is excluded from reuse**. One trace discrepancy to note: the fan-in prose cites "delivery comment 01a0ddc4-8de5" while binding digest `5fba147a…` — the digest belongs to `01a0ddc4-05ca`; treat `01a0ddc4-05ca` as the delivery reference.

No provider knowledge record exists yet (capture is a later Mission step), so this is a delivery-layer duplication only — no stored-record duplicate to reconcile. C2/C3 should re-derive and verify against `5fba147a…` (4122 bytes). The `c1:DELIVERED:r2` event was already posted by the concurrent run (parent `01a0ddc4-2681`) and fanned in; I deliberately do **not** post a second event, to avoid duplicate dispatch.

RC10VAL-12 remains `in_review` awaiting fresh C2/C3 gates on the canonical r2.
